Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.startup.state

Class StateImageLoader

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.startup.state.StateImageLoader
@Component public class StateImageLoader extends Object
Handles deferred image loading for State classes after Spring context is fully initialized. This prevents State constructors from trying to load images before the image loading infrastructure is ready.

State classes can define a method annotated with @PostStateConstruction that will be called by this loader after all dependencies are ready.

Since:
1.1.0
